svg.title: Level 2 - Decomposition of process 3.0
svg.text: Request-driven data transformations: retrieval, graph ranking, optional assessment/guidance, and read-only public exploration.
Process 2.0 receives and saves each response.
Evaluations and improvements are on demand.
Saved inputs can bypass retrieval stages.
Private query vectors are never cached in D6.
Yourdon-DeMarco: circle = process | rectangle = external entity | parallel lines = data store | arrow = data flow
Arrows name the data being transferred. Repeated IDs refer to the same entity/store. Line jumps are unconnected crossings.
